hooks.name: Pre-write secret scan
hooks.description: Before writing any file, scan content for common secret patterns (private keys, hardcoded passwords/tokens). Warns but does not block.

action.command:
FILE=$(echo "$KIRO_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('path','') or d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null)
CONTENT=$(echo "$KIRO_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('text','') or d.get('newStr',''))" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$CONTENT" ]; then
  # Check for common secret patterns
  if echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qE '(PRIVATE KEY|BEGIN RSA|password\s*=\s*"[^"]{8,}"|secret\s*=\s*"[^"]{8,}"|token\s*=\s*"[^"]{20,}"|api_key\s*=\s*"[^"]{10,}")'; then
    echo "⚠ Possible secret detected in file content — review before writing: $FILE"
    echo "  Use variables or environment-level secrets instead of hardcoded values."
  fi
fi
